experiments.scope: Selected target md5-s63-prefix-v1 on 16-byte trajectory messages. 256 organizer-seeded trials; each trial iterates the claim's iteration function f for at most 512 steps and returns the first pair of distinct messages whose digests agree on the leading 16 digest bits (digest bytes 0-1).
experiments.hypothesis: On the real fixed target, the seeded trajectory prefix search finds a 16-bit digest-prefix collision within 512 evaluations with per-trial frequency consistent with the random-mapping prediction 1 - exp(-512^2 / 2^17) = 1 - exp(-2) ~= 0.865, supporting the collision-search premises H1/H2 at 2^9-2^10 evaluation scale.
